name: Tiny Dungeon (three-brain)
pitch: A pixel-art dungeon crawler that runs in the browser. Explore rooms, dodge monsters, grab loot.

baton.ai: Three models plan, a judge merges, AI builds
baton.human: You approve the merged plan, review the screenshots, deploy by hand

facts: 6 stages · 2 flows · 2 review gates · manual deploy · needs Claude, Codex and Gemini runners

wip.how: Each stage shows wip used/limit. A flow never pulls a card into a full stage; the stage turns amber and the flow waits.
wip.why: One card in Plan runs three models at once. A limit of 2 caps how many runners and tokens planning can burn.
wip.here: Plan is full (2/2), so the Slime King stays in Backlog until you approve a plan.

Plan.text: Full: each card here is running three planners. DU40 waits in Backlog.

Review.text: Its own stage, so cards waiting on you don't use the build stage's slots.

three-brain-plan.blurb: three models plan side by side, a judge merges them, then one mockup

implement.blurb: a test loop on each task, then screenshots for you

cards.title: Boss fight: the Slime King
cards.description: A big green boss at the bottom of the dungeon that splits into smaller slimes when you hit it.

cards.title: Treasure chests with a loot table
cards.description: Chests that roll from a loot table, so every run turns up something different.

cards.title: Mini-map in the corner
cards.description: A small map of the rooms you've explored, with the hero as a blinking dot.

cards.title: Footstep and coin sounds
cards.description: Soft footsteps on stone and a bright clink when you pick up a coin.

cards.title: Save the game in the browser
cards.description: Close the tab and pick up where you left off, from the same room with the same loot.

cards.title: Torchlight and fog of war
cards.description: Only the tiles near the hero's torch are lit; rooms you haven't seen stay dark.

cards.title: Inventory bar along the bottom
cards.description: A row of slots along the bottom of the screen for the loot you're carrying.

cards.title: Bat enemy that swoops at you
cards.description: A bat that hangs from the ceiling, then dives at the hero when they come close.

tasks.title: Swoop when the hero is in range

cards.title: Hero walk cycle (4 frames)
cards.description: A four-frame walk for the hero in each direction, so moving looks like walking, not sliding.

tasks.title: Play them while the hero moves

cards.title: Coins and a score counter
cards.description: Coins scattered through the rooms and a score in the top corner that counts them up.

cards.title: Tile map renderer
cards.description: Draw a room from a grid of floor and wall tiles.

cards.title: Move the hero with arrow keys
cards.description: The arrow keys step the hero one tile at a time.

cards.title: Walls block movement
cards.description: The hero stops at a wall instead of walking through it.
